paras: As Proverbs says, “Drink water” (Prov. 5:15; 6:24). Later (5:17) and Gen 1:1–2:3.
In verse 18 he adds more. See Song of Sol. 7:11–8:7 and 1 Cor 7:4a.
The word λόγος (cf. λόγου) and חֶסֶד appear; the covenant and the new covenant.
Quote: Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ λόγος, a covenant quoted at length here.
Indented: this indented paragraph of prose quotes the covenant at some length, mentioning λόγος and חֶסֶד in passing too.
John writes Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὁ λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν θεόν (John 1:1).

notes.text: On חַסְדּוֹ see the lexicons; also the Davidic covenant.

paras: Smith, John. Notes on Romans 9:1–5 and the covenant. Grand Rapids: Baker, 1990.
